signature.id: Segel pada amplop; jika isi berubah, segelnya rusak.
signature.en: A seal on an envelope; if the contents change, the seal breaks.

encryption.id: Mengunci isi agar hanya penerima yang bisa membuka.
encryption.en: Locking the contents so only the receiver can open them.

nonce.id: Kode unik sekali pakai pada tiap pesan.
nonce.en: A one-time code attached to every message.

timestamp.id: Cap waktu pengiriman; pesan lama ditolak.
timestamp.en: The send time; old messages are rejected.

replay.id: Orang menyalin pesan sah lalu mengirimnya lagi.
replay.en: Someone copies a valid message and sends it again.

replay-store.id: Buku catatan tiket (nonce) yang sudah dipakai.
replay-store.en: A logbook of tickets (nonces) already used.

clock-skew.id: Toleransi jika jam dua server tidak persis sama.
clock-skew.en: Allowed difference between two servers' clocks.

key-id.id: Rahasia yang dipakai; nomor versi kuncinya.
key-id.en: The secret in use; and its version number.

kms.en: A vault that stores and wraps keys.

key-wrapping.id: Menyimpan kunci di dalam kotak terkunci lain.
key-wrapping.en: Keeping a key inside another locked box.

ed25519.id: Pengirim punya kunci pribadi; penerima hanya kunci publik.
ed25519.en: Sender holds a private key; receiver only holds a public key.

post-quantum.id: Persiapan menghadapi komputer kuantum di masa depan.

middleware.id: Lapisan yang memeriksa request sebelum sampai ke aplikasi.
middleware.en: A layer that checks a request before it reaches your app.

webhook.id: Pesan otomatis dari sistem lain ke server Anda.
webhook.en: An automatic message another system sends to your server.

load-balancer.id: Pembagi lalu lintas ke beberapa server.
load-balancer.en: A traffic splitter across several servers.

protocol-version.id: “Bahasa” wire yang harus sama di kedua sisi (default 4).
protocol-version.en: The wire “language” both sides must share (default 4).

canonical-request.id: Bentuk baku method/path/query agar tanda tangan cocok.
canonical-request.en: A normalized method/path/query so signatures match.
